result.title: One-Shot Hierarchical Federated Clustering for Distributed Non-IID Biomedical Data Analysis
result.summary: In multi-institutional biomedical data analysis, comprehensive disease profiles are often fragmented across different data silos. Furthermore, local data distributions typically exhibit varying levels of granularity or even complex nested structures. Although Hierarchical Clustering (HC) is a powerful tool for exploring such data topologies, its cumbersome recursive process incurs prohibitive computational overhead and renders it highly susceptible to privacy leakage. This paper, therefore, introduces an efficient one-shot hierarchical FC framework that performs client-end (institutions) distribution exploration and server-end distribution aggregation through one-way prototype-level communication from clients to the server. Although the designed one-shot prototype transmission guarantees minimal computational overhead and mitigates privacy risks, it inevitably incurs information loss. To counteract this, a multi-granular competitive learning mechanism is proposed on the server to fuse the clusterlets, effectively maximizing the retention and mining of global distribution topologies under limited, one-way communication constraints. It turns out that the complex cluster distributions across clients can be efficiently explored, and extensive experiments comparing state-of-the-art methods on public datasets demonstrate the superiority of the proposed framework in balancing robust clustering, privacy preservation, and computational efficiency.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一次性分层联邦聚类框架：客户端本地探索分布，仅通过单向原型级通信上传到服务器，服务器用多粒度竞争学习融合 clusterlet 以缓解单向传输的信息损失，用于多机构非 IID 生物医学数据。
AI.relevance_reason: 该工作是无视觉输入、无推理轨迹的联邦聚类方法，单向原型传输与信息损失属于通信压缩问题，和 LVR 的内部状态表示、证据获取与停止决策缺少具体衔接，暂不构成可核查的借鉴线索。
